Gleuhr Guide — Doctor (draft)
 Oct 27, 2026  ·  @Aman
This is the draft of the doctor's module of the Gleuhr Guide, for your approval before it is
built into the app. It covers the doctor's desk and the support doctor, who works the same
desk.
How it was checked: every button name and step was read from the app as it is today
(27 Oct). Every refusal message is quoted from the server. Nothing comes from
memory or the old manual.
No money: the doctor's guide carries no amount, price or balance anywhere, the same
rule as her screens.
Screenshots: made-up data only. The drafts point to them in brackets; they will be
placed when the guide is built into the app.
Still being written: Part 2 (Rules) and Part 4 (Operational requirements), which come
from the training framework you added today.
How to review: comment on any line, or edit it directly. Anything you change becomes
the text staff see.
1 · Responsibilities
What this desk is for. You make the clinical decisions. For a new patient you write the
treatment plan. For a returning patient you build today's session and sign it off. No session
can start until you sign it off. After the treatment you check her home-care routine, book
her next visit and close your side of the visit.
What you decide.
Which treatments she needs, and how many sessions of each (the consult).
What is done today: the treatment, the procedure, serums, minutes, and who performs
it (the sign-off).
Her skin progress for each course (Baseline · Slight · Improving · Strong · Regressing).
When she should come back (the next appointment date).
Her home-care routine, when nothing was prescribed before.
What you never decide.
What she buys, and how it is spread over visits. That is the counsellor.
Check-in and the front desk. That is reception.
Approving a corrected session count. That is the branch manager (BM).

blocks.title: Page 2
blocks.text:
Ending a patient's journey with us (a hard-close). Only a counsellor does that. Your
screens have no button for it.
Your screens show the patient, her skin, her plan and the room. They never show
anything commercial. That is on purpose: the clinical decision and the commercial
decision are made by different people.
Who hands work to you, and who you hand it to.
Your day.
1 . Sign in. You land on Clinic Status → Waiting area.
2. The Morning Huddle: for each cross-sell patient, choose who pitches. Write a recovery
plan for an at-risk patient.
3. All day: new patients from New consults; returning patients from the Session Builder;
your own treatments from My sessions.
4. After each treatment: Post-treatment review, then Close visit ✓.
5. Your check-in calls on Follow-ups.
6. Before you leave: Close my day. The last doctor to close also closes the clinic's clinical
day. After that, the BM locks the clinic's day on the End of Day.
If you were a support doctor
There is no separate support doctor desk any more. Every doctor at every clinic has Post-
treatment review, and every support doctor login is now a Doctor login. An old support-
doctor address takes you to the Doctor desk ("Moving you to the Doctor desk…").

blocks.title: Page 3
blocks.text:
If a login still carried the old support-doctor role, three things would differ until it is
moved: no follow-up check-in Call button; no "Unanswered alarms today" on Clinic Status;
and in the sign-off panel only the next appointment can be booked ("the support doctor
books the next appointment only — the sign-off and the skin result are the doctor's"). No
login is on the old role today.
2 · Rules
These are the rules that bind your desk. The app enforces most of them, so you can't
break them by mistake. Know them anyway.
The rule Why
Only a checked-in patient reaches you. A
future booking never shows a consult or a
sign-off.
Check-in is the one door into the clinic's day,
so every visit is counted.
No session can start before you sign it off. The clinical decision comes before the
treatment, every time.
You never end a patient's journey. Only the
counsellor closes a patient.
The person who owns the relationship
makes that call.
Your "Close visit ✓ " closes only today's
clinical side, and it needs a next date or a
reason.
No patient leaves without a next step.
A therapist who does something different
from your sign-off keeps both versions.
Nothing you signed is overwritten.
Changes are recorded, never hidden.
The plan you write is fixed. Sessions done
are counted from the logs, never typed in.
Unit treatments are planned in their own
unit (ml, units, threads).
The count is always true and can be
checked.
A wrong session count is corrected by
sending it to the BM. You never change it
yourself.
The person who checks is not the person
who asks.
A skin result is recorded or changed only on
the visit's own day: one result per course.
A result is a record of that day, not of today.
One huddle decision per patient per day. A change is tomorrow's decision.
A severe reaction on a check-in call is a
concern: she is called again.
No reaction is closed without a doctor
hearing it.

blocks.title: Page 4
blocks.text:
3 · Processes
My pages
The menu is one list, in this order. On the phone, four pages sit in the bottom bar (Clinic
Status, Session Builder, New consults, All patients). Everything else is under ☰ .
Clinic Status — your home page. Six views: Waiting area · Numbing · Therapists · Rooms
· Stage · Next 2 hours. Tap any row to open its session details. From here you Sign off ›,
Assign ›, Start consult ›, start and log your own sessions, and close a therapist's logged
session. My sessions (top right) shows only the treatments you perform. The count on
the menu is the number of patients in treatment now.
Clinic Overview — the floor on one screen: who is waiting for a sign-off, who is waiting
for a therapist, numbing and treatment times, rooms, and delay alarms.
Clinic Timeline — every step of the day in time order. Filters: All today · Late · Next 30
min · Done. View only.
Therapist planner — each therapist's day as blocks. Drag a patient to a therapist to
plan who treats her next.
My sessions — only the treatments you perform: All today · To do · Done.
Team today — mark a doctor or therapist absent for today (Mark absent), or back
(Mark present).
Session Builder — your sign-off desk. Tabs: In clinic · Upcoming appointments ·
Completed · Not closed (earlier days).
The rule Why
A post-treatment record is never
overwritten.
Records are added, not edited.
Your screens show nothing commercial.
Questions about buying go to the counsellor.
Text that people typed by hand (booking
notes, tickets, notes) reaches you as they
typed it.
The clinical and commercial decisions are
kept apart.
A stock tag is a hint, never a block. You
prescribe what the patient needs.
The prescription is yours, whatever the shelf
holds.
Everything you save is saved in your name.
Never work on another doctor's login.
Every action has a real person behind it.
Gleuhr Guide — Doctor (draft)

blocks.title: Page 5
blocks.text:
Post-treatment review — the last clinical touch: teach or check the home-care routine,
then close the visit. Tabs: Waiting · Treatment Ongoing · Post-treatment Review
Pending · Post-treatment Review Done.
New consults — today's first-visit patients: Consults to see · Incomplete · Consulted.
Morning Huddle — Cross-sell and At-risk. For each cross-sell patient: who pitches, the
doctor or the counsellor.
Follow-ups — your clinical check-in calls: Today's list · Overdue · All follow-ups ·
Planned returns · To pitch.
Appointments — the clinic's bookings for a day. Read only.
Next appointments — patients brought over from the old system who still have
sessions left and no next appointment. Book one from here.
Visit history — the clinic's treatment sessions for a date or a range, and Not closed
(earlier days).
All patients — the whole clinic's patient list. Search, Peek, Open, Open follow-up.
Tickets — To me · From me · To confirm. + Raise ticket.
Patient Results — each patient's skin result, visit by visit, with filters. It opens on "Me"
(your own patients); pick "All doctors" to see the whole clinic.
Close my day — what is still open today, and the Close my day button. The count is the
number of items left.

blocks.title: Page 6
blocks.text:
At the top of every page: the search box ("Search name or phone…") opens any patient
of your clinic. The ? menu has How to use and Report a bug. Your name menu has your
profile, Sign out and, if you hold two desks, Switch desk.
How do I…? · Getting around
1. How do I ﬁnd a patient quickly?
When you need this: a patient is in front of you, or someone asks about her.
Steps:
1 . Type her name or phone number in the search box at the top ("Search name or
phone…").
2. Pick her from the list. Her record opens.
3. To see the whole list instead, open All patients and search there ("Search name /
phone / # — whole clinic").
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: the top search finds patients of your own clinic. If she is
not found, check the spelling or search by phone.
Who to ask: reception, if she should be here today and is not on any list.
Search words: find patient, search, patient kahan hai, naam se dhundo, phone number,
record kholna, open record, peek

2. How do I read a patient's record?
When you need this: before a consult or a sign-off, or when someone asks about her
history.
Steps:
1 . Press Peek on any row. A side panel shows her treatments, follow-ups, notes, cross-
sells and tickets.
2. Press Open (or the full-record link in the Peek) for the whole record. Its tabs: Overview
· Journey · Appointments · Cross-sell · Follow-up · Tickets · Communications · Notes ·
Activity, and Photos.
3. To print or download a prescription from a past visit, open that visit in the record and
use Print prescription or Download PDF.
What you'll see: the record is drawn through the doctor's view. Commercial blocks are not
there — that is on purpose, not a fault.
Who to ask: the counsellor for anything about her package.
Search words: record, history, patient file, peek, purani visit, previous visit, prescription
print, download prescription, photos
[Screenshot to add: the doctor's patient record, Overview tab]
How do I…? · New patients — the consult
3. How do I see a new patient?
When you need this: a first-visit patient is checked in and waiting for you.
Steps:
1 . Open New consults (or press Start consult › on her row in Clinic Status).
2. Under Consults to see, find her card and press Start consult →.
3. Fill the Patient & assessment tab: Primary concern, history, medication, treatment
taken before, allergies; then What you observe — Fitzpatrick and Skin type.
4. Open the Recommendation tab and write the plan (card 4).
5. Press Save & send to counsellor →. Then Done — back to new consults.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
The card says what is still missing: "Printing and sending are off until this consult is
complete — still needed: the primary concern, the skin assessment (Fitzpatrick + skin
type) and a recommendation (or "No treatment recommended")." Fill what it names.
Gleuhr Guide — Doctor (draft)

blocks.text:
The server refuses an incomplete plan: "recommendation needs at least one treatment
line — or "No treatment recommended" ticked". Add a line or tick it.
"This patient isn't checked in today — reception checks them in first." Ask reception to
check her in.
Who to ask: the counsellor takes the plan from here.
Search words: new patient, consult, first visit, naya patient, consultation, start consult,
plan banana, assessment, Fitzpatrick, skin type
Screenshot:
4. How do I write the treatment plan?
When you need this: on the Recommendation tab of a consult.
Steps:
1 . Pick a package from Select package…, or a single treatment from Select single
session…. The clinic's usual plan may already be filled in ("Opened on the clinic's usual
plan — change it, or clear it and start from blank.").
2. For each treatment line, set the Planned sessions. Unit-based treatments (ml, units,
threads) are planned in their own unit.
3. Add Diet & Supplements and the Products Regime ( ☀  Morning (AM), ☾  Night (PM)).
Gleuhr Guide — Doctor (draft)
Page 8 of 38

blocks.title: Page 9
blocks.text:
4. Write a Prescription note (it prints) and an Internal note (it does not print).
5. If she needs nothing, tick No treatment recommended instead. The counsellor then
closes the visit as consult only.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: you cannot have treatment lines and "No treatment
recommended" together. The card says "either the treatment lines or "No treatment
recommended" — not both". Press Clear on the plan, or untick the box.
Who to ask: the counsellor decides what she buys from your plan.
Search words: treatment plan, recommendation, package, sessions, planned sessions, no
treatment, regime, AM PM, supplements, diet, prescription note
Screenshot:
5. How do I print a prescription?
When you need this: the patient wants her prescription on paper.
Steps:
1 . Before you send the consult: press Print prescription at the foot of the consult. It
works once the consult is complete.
2. After you send it: open New consults → Consulted, find her card and press Print
prescription there.
Gleuhr Guide — Doctor (draft)
Page 9 of 38

blocks.title: Page 10
blocks.text:
3. From any later day: open her record, open the visit, and press Print prescription or
Download PDF.
What you'll see: a greyed button says what is missing, e.g. "Still needed: the primary
concern".
Who to ask: reception, if the printer does not work.
Search words: print, prescription, Rx, parchi, PDF, download, letterhead, print nahi ho raha
[Screenshot to add: New consults → Consulted card with Print prescription]
6. How do I ﬁnish a consult I started earlier?
When you need this: you were called away in the middle of a consult.
Steps:
1 . Open New consults → Incomplete.
2. Press Start consult → on her card. Your draft comes back.
3. Finish and press Save & send to counsellor →.
What you'll see: "Draft saved in this browser tab — it is kept until you close the tab." A
draft lives only in this browser tab. If you close the tab or sign out, the draft is gone.
Who to ask: nobody — finish it yourself. Close my day lists it as "consults you started not
saved".
Search words: draft, incomplete, unfinished consult, adhura, resume, save nahi hua
[Screenshot to add: New consults → Incomplete]
How do I…? · Returning patients — the sign-off
7. How do I sign off today's session?
When you need this: a returning patient is checked in and waiting in Waiting session
sign-off.
Steps:
1 . Open Session Builder → In clinic, or press Sign off › on her row in Clinic Status.
2. Press Build › on her row. The sign-off panel opens. On the left: her before photos, active
treatments and past sessions.
3. Step 1, Build today's session: pick the treatment in Select active treatment and Select
treatment for this session. Add Serums (+ Serum) and the Duration. Under
Performed by, pick Therapist or Doctor. Tick Complimentary if it is beyond the plan.
4. Press Add treatment to session. For more, press + Add a session.
Gleuhr Guide — Doctor (draft)

5. Step 2, Record skin progress: one result per course worked today.
6. Step 3, Assign therapist (or leave it — "not assigned · or reception assigns").
7. Step 4, Next appointment date (card 12).
8. Press Save and start session.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
The greyed button says why: "Create the session first", "Add the treatment to the
session first", "Open the session count first".
"No before photo yet — it never blocks the sign-off". You can go ahead.
"This visit is already signed off — change its sessions with Edit". Use Edit (card 9).
Who to ask: the therapist takes it from here; reception assigns a therapist if you did not.

When you need this: step 2 of the sign-off, after you add a session.
Steps:

9. How do I change a session after I signed it off?
When you need this: you need a different treatment, more serums, or one more session
on the same visit.
Steps:
1 . Open her row in Session Builder. The panel shows "Signed off".
2. Press Edit on step 1 (or Add a session, once every session has started).
3. Make the change and save. The footer says "Saving keeps the sign-off; the therapist's
list updates".
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
A session the therapist has already started is locked: "This session has started — it
stays as signed off; a change now is the therapist's deviation to record."
"Edited after the sign-off — both versions are kept". Nothing is overwritten.
Who to ask: the therapist, if the change is about a session already running.
Search words: edit session, change sign-off, galti, correction, add session, extra session,
badalna

10. How do I undo a sign-off?
When you need this: you signed off by mistake, and the therapist has not started.
Steps:
1 . Open the patient's panel and press Undo on step 1.
2. Read the box, then press Undo sign-off. (Keep it leaves it as it is.)
3. She goes back to Sign off. Sign her off again, or record No treatment today (card 11).
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"The visit can't be closed until you sign it again or record No treatment today."
If the therapist has already started: "a session has started — the whole sign-off can no
longer be undone. Remove the sessions not started yet instead." Press Remove the
sessions not started, then Remove them.
Who to ask: the therapist, if a session already started.
Search words: undo, cancel sign-off, wapas lena, mistake, galat sign off, remove session
[Screenshot to add: Undo the sign-off? dialog]
11. How do I record that there is no treatment today?
When you need this: she came in but will not be treated today.
Gleuhr Guide — Doctor (draft)

Steps:
1 . After you undid a sign-off (or signed off with no treatment): press No treatment
today in the panel, write why if you like, and press Record no treatment. The
counsellor can then close the visit.
2. After the counsellor closed her part, with nothing signed off: the panel shows a No
treatment today card. Pick a reason, write it if you chose Other, and press Close · no
treatment ✓.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"a session is signed off or started on this visit — close it with the treatment, not "No
treatment today"".
"the counsellor has not closed this visit yet — "No treatment today" opens after her
close".
"The reasons for "no treatment" are not set up — ask the admin."
Who to ask: the counsellor closes her part of the visit.

12. How do I book the next appointment?
When you need this: every treatment visit you sign off should leave with a next date.
Steps:
1 . In the sign-off panel, open step 4, Next appointment date.
2. For each treatment, press 7, 14, 21 or 30 days, or Custom date to open the calendar. 21
days is picked to start with.
3. Save with the sign-off, or press Save after. If she has no active treatment left, pick a
date and press Book.
4. To change a booked date, press Move on step 4.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"The next visit has to be a future date."
"that booking is no longer an open future visit — plan a new one".
"The default next-visit setting couldn't load — pick a date per treatment."
Who to ask: reception confirms the time with her.
Search words: next appointment, next visit, agli date, follow-up date, book, reschedule,
move date, kab aana hai
[Screenshot to add: sign-off panel, step 4 Next appointment date]
13. How do I assign or change the therapist?
When you need this: you want a particular therapist for this session.
Steps:
1 . In the panel, open step 3, Assign therapist, and pick from Choose therapist…. Each
name shows "free", "will queue" or "away today".
2. Or press Assign › on her row in Clinic Status, pick a therapist and press Assign.
3. To change it, press Change on step 3. The latest pick stands — yours or reception's.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"The session has started — a change of hands now is the therapist's deviation to
record."
"No active therapist at this clinic."
If you marked a session "Doctor" and reception later gave it to a therapist, the panel
says so: "Reception gave … to … — it is the therapist's session now."
Who to ask: reception assigns when you leave it open.

14. How do I open the session count for a package from the old system?
When you need this: the panel says "… came from the old CRM — How many sessions
she already had isn't known yet".
Steps:
1 . Press Open the session count.
2. Enter Sessions in the package and Already taken. Enter both numbers — The card
says and The patient says. If they differ, the lower one is recorded and noted.
3. Save. The plan refreshes ("Refreshing the plan with the opened count…"), and you can
build the session.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "Already taken can't be more than the sessions in the
package." / "Enter both numbers."
Who to ask: the BM, if the numbers are disputed.
Search words: old CRM, purana package, session count, card count, kitne session hue,
imported package, count open
[Screenshot to add: sign-off panel, Open the session count form]
15. How do I correct a wrong session count?
When you need this: the count on her package is wrong, or "No session left on the count
from her old card".
Steps:
1 . Under step 1, press Correct the count ›.
2. Change Sessions in the package and/or Sessions taken.
3. Write Why — "the BM decides on your reason".
4. Press Send to the BM.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong: "Change the total or the sessions taken first." / "Taken
can't be more than the total." / "Say why the count is wrong — the BM decides on your
reason."
Who to ask: the BM approves it. Until then the count does not change.
Search words: count wrong, session count galat, correct count, sessions left, BM
approval, count theek karna

16. How do I add the real treatment to an old customised plan?
When you need this: an old-system plan names no current treatment ("a plan from the old
system with no current treatment named on it").
Steps:
1 . Press Add a treatment to this plan ›.
2. Pick the treatment and write Why — "it is kept on the plan as a revision".
3. Press Add to the plan. "the plan keeps its original line; this is added beside it · the
session count does not change".
Who to ask: the counsellor, if the plan itself is wrong.
Search words: customised plan, old plan, treatment add karna, plan revision, customized

17. How do I record a patient's paper card when she has no package?
When you need this: the panel says "No active package for this patient", and she has a
paper card from before.
Steps:
1 . On the Paper card from before side, press Record a card.
2. Fill Treatment name, as the card states it, Sessions on the card, Already used, and
What the card says, in words. Add a Photo of the card if you can.
3. Press Record the card. The package appears in the builder and you build the session.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
While the counsellor is putting a package together, the button is greyed: "Not while the
counsellor is selling — a card now would split today's sessions from the sale." The
package appears by itself — "No action needed here — it appears by itself."
"The typed card note is required evidence." / "This card is spent — there is nothing left
to record." / "this exact card is already recorded for this patient".
Who to ask: the counsellor, if she has no card and no package.
Search words: paper card, purana card, card record, no package, package nahi hai, old
card, card photo

How do I…? · Your own treatments
18. How do I perform a treatment myself?
When you need this: you chose Performed by: Doctor for a session.
Steps:
1 . Open My sessions (or press My sessions on Clinic Status). Tap the session.
2. Press Start session →. The session page has three steps: Start · Record · Complete.
3. Start: check the Before photos, choose the Room, tick every pre-treatment item, then
press Start treatment.
4. Record: enter how much was Delivered (in the treatment's own unit), the Duration,
any Serums and the Reaction. Fill What was different only if you did something
different from the sign-off.
5. Complete: add the After photo, tick every post-treatment item, and press Complete
session.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"Take the machine settings photo first — this treatment needs it before it starts."
"that room is in use — another sitting holds it until it is recorded or closed; choose
another room".
Gleuhr Guide — Doctor (draft)
Page 18 of 38

blocks.text:
"No pre-treatment checklist is set up — ask the branch manager."
Who to ask: the BM, for rooms and checklists.

start, log session
[Screenshot to add: My sessions with one session To do]
19. How do I tick my own treatment done without the session form?
When you need this: you did a short treatment yourself, exactly as signed off.
Steps:
1 . In Session Builder, find her under Your treatment to tick.
2. Press Done ✓  <treatment>, then Yes, done ✓ ("Done as signed off?").
3. You can also tick it on the Close visit card in the panel.
What you'll see / if it goes wrong:
"… — a session was started on it at …. Save it from your session log (My sessions), not
with a tick."
"… is already logged today".
"the therapist performs this treatment — she logs it on her desk".
Who to ask: nobody — it is yours.
Search words: tick done, done mark, treatment ho gaya, apna treatment, doctor tick,
session done
[Screenshot to add: Session Builder, Your treatment to tick group]
20. How do I choose who puts on the numbing cream?
When you need this: a session needs numbing and you want a particular therapist to do it.
Steps:
1 . On Clinic Status, tap the session. The footer says "Numbing is the therapist's step —
you can pick who numbs".
2. Under Numbing by, pick the therapist.
3. To undo, pick Clear — any therapist may numb.

5 · Training & assessment
How you are scored
You pass two parts, separately. A good score in one never makes up for the other.
Every attempt and every rating is kept. You are Trained when every lesson is passed AND
every task is rated 4 or 5. Until then you are In training, and nothing is blocked. (Trained
and In training are coming with the Guide; they are not in the app yet.)

5 — did it alone, right first time, at normal desk speed.
4 — did it alone and right, but slower, or caught and fixed your own small slip.
3 — needed one prompt from the BM, or made one mistake the BM had to point out.

Ready for sign-off — what your BM will ask you to show
When you have passed every lesson, your BM watches you do these on the real desk, with
real patients. Then your BM signs you off as Trained. Until then your desk shows In
training, but nothing is blocked. (The Trained sign-off and the In training badge are coming
with the Guide; they are not in the app yet.)
1 . See a new patient: complete the consult, send it to the counsellor, and print her
prescription.
What a 5 looks like: opens her from Consults to see with Start consult →; fills the
primary concern, Fitzpatrick and skin type without the footer having to name them;
writes plan lines with planned sessions (or ticks No treatment recommended, never
both); presses Save & send to counsellor → and prints from Print prescription.
2. Sign off a returning patient: build the session, record her skin result, assign a
therapist and book the next date.
What a 5 looks like: picks the right active treatment, duration and Performed by;
records one result per course worked today; assigns a therapist or leaves it knowingly
to reception; books every treatment's next date with the day buttons, then Save and
start session.
3. Undo a sign-off before the therapist starts, then sign it again (or record "No
treatment today").
What a 5 looks like: checks the therapist has not started; uses Undo → Undo sign-off
(or, once a session has started, Remove the sessions not started); then signs again or
records No treatment today, so the visit can still close.
4. Do a post-treatment review — teach or check the routine — and close the visit from
your side.
What a 5 looks like: starts only from Post-treatment Review Pending; places every
prescribed product in a step and gives every supplement a time (or records adherence
for a check-in); sets a next date for every active treatment or picks a reason; prints the
